steps.title: Let’s get you playing ⛳
body: We’ll show you the basics as you go.
Watch. Try it yourself. Then tap Next.
You can end the tutorial at any time.

steps.title: Let’s hit a few balls first

media.alt: Tapping Practice, then Practice Range in GSPro

steps.title: Wait for this screen

media.alt: The Practice Range fully loaded in GSPro

body: Once your bottom screen looks like this:

steps.title: Get the ball ready 🟢

media.alt: The ball registering in the hitting zone and the Uneekor light turning green

body: Place your ball inside the hitting square.
Try moving the ball out and back in.

steps.title: Ready? Take a swing! 🏌️

media.alt: A shot being hit on the Practice Range with the ball trace shown

body: Take as many practice swings as you like.
When you’re ready, hit the ball at the screen.
Watch the ball flight and your shot stats appear.

media.alt: Tapping the four dots and selecting End Round in GSPro

steps.title: Pick your course

media.alt: Choosing a course and tapping Play in GSPro

body: Choose a downloaded course and tap Play.
Want another one? Use All Courses to search and download more.

steps.title: Make it your game

media.alt: Choosing round settings and players in GSPro

body: Then tap Play in the bottom-right.
Once the game starts loading, tap Next.

steps.title: You’re ready! 🏌️

media.alt: Hitting the first shot on a golf course

body: Put your ball in the hitting zone.

steps.title: Want to stop or change course?

media.alt: Tapping the four dots and selecting End Round in GSPro

body: You can do this at any time.

steps.title: Want to keep playing? ⏱️

media.alt: Tapping Extend Session and entering a booking code

body: Your remaining time is always shown in the corner.
Book the next session in the same bay.
Then tap Extend Session → Enter the new 6-digit code.
Your extra time will be added automatically.

steps.title: Need a hand?

media.alt: Opening Help from the corner of the screen

body: You can also restart this Quick Start Tutorial from there.

steps.title: Something gone wrong?

media.alt: Opening Help, selecting Incident Report and scanning the QR code

body: Scan the QR code with your phone and tell us what happened.

steps.title: Control your bay light 💡

media.alt: Tapping the Light button to toggle the bay light

body: Tap the Light button to turn it on or off.

steps.title: That’s it. You’re ready! ⛳
body: You know everything you need to get started.
